contract.name: account
contract.description: The guide permits lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscore in account names. This checks the physically extracted slot, not account assignment or receiver parsing of injected delimiters.

contract.name: tmsec
contract.description: The guide defines two nonempty section parts separated by one underscore: lowercase Latin letters and digits on the left; the same plus hyphen on the right. It states that nonconforming sections are not counted. Other path layouts remain unvalidated.

contract.name: param1
contract.description: The current public producer forwards this optional opaque prefix slot with a truthy override or empty fallback. No format or receiver-wide requiredness is inferred.

contract.name: referrer
contract.description: The producer escapes stars only for document.referrer, while explicit truthy referrers are forwarded unchanged. Empty and opaque values remain open. Query or fragment delimiters can hide later path slots and leave the request outside this profile.

contract.name: random
contract.description: The published JavaScript appends Math.round(Math.random()*1E9); Flash examples use a smaller range. The no-script image leaves this suffix empty. This is producer-shape advice, not a receiver quota.

contract.name: method
contract.description: Published image templates and the pinned Image.src producer issue GET requests. This warning does not establish a receiver-wide method or body contract.

field_interpretation.account: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscore; no assigned-ID validation or length cap.
field_interpretation.tmsec: Two nonempty parts separated by one underscore; left lowercase Latin/digits, right lowercase Latin/digits/hyphen.
field_interpretation.param1: Open optional source prefix; truthy fourth hit argument overrides option, otherwise empty fallback.
field_interpretation.referrer: Open optional referrer. Default document referrer escapes stars; explicit truthy third hit argument is unescaped.
field_interpretation.random: Optional empty no-script suffix or canonical Math.round decimal output from 0 through 1000000000; Flash examples are a subset. A regex preserves allow_empty because numeric bounds run before the generic empty check.
field_interpretation.http.method: GET advice from Image.src and image tags only.
